scenes.visual_plan: Hook: faint random dots drift in behind a big kinetic question 'Can random dots find π?'; then a chip with a dice icon names the Monte Carlo method
A square with an inscribed circle draws itself; seeded random dots rain into the square; on cue, dots inside the circle turn sky and outside ones purple, with live inside/total counters
Formula derivation with TransformMatchingTex: inside/total ≈ π/4, then π ≈ 4 · inside/total, then the numbers from the scene 2 sample giving the estimate
Axes with a logarithmic dots axis; the running estimate of π is traced as dots accumulate, jumping early and settling on a dashed line at π
Formula error ∝ 1/√n; below, two rows compare 100 dots with error about 0.1 and 10,000 dots with error about 0.01, with ×100 and ÷10 arrows
Recap: three cards light up in turn (random dots, a simple ratio, enough samples); then a row of use-case chips with icons (physics, finance, graphics)
